jobs.description:
About this vacancy
As an Experienced DataStage Developer, you play a key role in maintaining and evolving a critical legacy data platform while supporting the organization's transition towards a modern cloud-based data ecosystem. You ensure the stability, performance, and continuity of existing DataStage solutions while contributing to migration initiatives towards Microsoft Azure and modern data platforms.
Your responsibilities include:
• Maintaining, supporting, and enhancing existing IBM DataStage ETL workflows and data integration processes.
• Performing impact analyses and implementing small to medium-sized changes to the legacy data platform.
• Troubleshooting production issues and ensuring the reliability of data pipelines.
• Collaborating with business users, analysts, and technical teams to deliver ongoing improvements.
• Supporting the migration of data workloads from on-premises environments to Azure-based data platforms.
• Assisting in the redesign and modernization of data integration processes and architectures.
• Ensuring data quality, security, governance, and compliance standards are upheld.
• Documenting existing solutions, enhancements, and migration activities.
• Contributing to knowledge transfer and helping bridge the gap between legacy and cloud technologies.
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a DataStage Developer, ETL Developer, or in a similar data integration role.
• Strong hands-on experience with IBM DataStage development, maintenance, and support.
• Solid knowledge of ETL processes, data integration, data mapping, and data quality principles.
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with relational databases.
• Experience maintaining and enhancing legacy data platforms in enterprise environments.
• Exposure to cloud technologies and data modernization initiatives.
• Experience with Microsoft Azure data services is considered a strong plus.
• Familiarity with modern data engineering concepts, data lakes, and cloud-based architectures is an advantage.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
• Professional proficiency in French and English is mandatory.

About this vacancy
As an AWS Data Engineer, you build the foundations for data-driven decision-making. You design, develop, and maintain scalable data platforms, integrate multiple data sources, and ensure reliable and efficient data infrastructure across cloud environments, with a strong focus on AWS.
Your responsibilities include:
• Designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.
• Integrating structured and unstructured data sources from various systems.
• Optimizing data storage and processing solutions, primarily in AWS cloud environments.
• Collaborating with Data Scientists, BI specialists, analysts, and business stakeholders.
• Ensuring data quality, security, governance, and compliance standards.
• Documenting data flows, architectures, and technical solutions.
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of data engineering best practices and cloud-native solutions.
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.
• Strong hands-on experience with AWS data services such as S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, EMR, Athena, or related technologies.
• Experience with tools and technologies such as SQL, Python, Spark, Airflow, and dbt.
• Solid understanding of data warehousing, data lakes, and streaming technologies.
• Experience designing and maintaining scalable cloud-based data platforms.
• Knowledge of Azure is considered a plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• Professional proficiency in French and English is mandatory.

About this vacancy
As a SharePoint Specialist, you are responsible for ensuring a secure, scalable, and well-governed SharePoint environment that supports collaboration, content management, and business productivity across the organization. Working within the broader Microsoft 365 ecosystem, you play a key role in maintaining operational excellence while supporting end users and driving adoption of best practices.

 
Your responsibilities include:
• Administering and configuring SharePoint Online, including site collections, hub sites, permissions, and sharing settings.
• Designing, implementing, and maintaining effective information architectures, including site structures, metadata models, and content types.
• Ensuring SharePoint environments comply with established governance, security, and Microsoft 365 standards.
• Managing access controls and collaboration settings in accordance with corporate IT security policies.
• Supporting business users in the effective use of SharePoint as a collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and document management platform.
• Handling user requests, incidents, and operational support activities related to SharePoint.
• Collaborating with Microsoft 365 specialists to deliver a cohesive and governed digital workplace experience.
• Working alongside Power Platform teams to enable controlled and sustainable citizen development initiatives.
• Supporting integrations with Power BI where SharePoint serves as a data repository or document source.
• Contributing to the full lifecycle management of SharePoint sites, including provisioning, reviews, archiving, and decommissioning.
• Documenting configurations, governance processes, and operational procedures.
What we expect from you
• Minimum 3 years of experience in SharePoint administration, support, or a similar Microsoft 365-focused role.
• Strong hands-on expertise with SharePoint Online and the modern SharePoint experience.
• Solid knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, and Entra ID.
• Proven experience managing permissions, access models, sharing mechanisms, and security configurations.
• Strong understanding of information architecture, content governance, and collaboration best practices.
• Experience working in enterprise-scale or regulated environments.
• Ability to balance operational support, incident management, and continuous platform improvement.
• Familiarity with Power Platform solutions such as Power Apps and Power Automate is considered a plus.
• Experience with Power BI integration scenarios is an advantage.
• Knowledge of records management, retention policies, sensitivity labels, and compliance features is a plus.
• Experience writing and maintaining PowerShell scripts is considered an asset.
• Microsoft 365 and/or SharePoint certifications are highly valued.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.Language requirements
• Professional proficiency in English is mandatory.
• Knowledge of French or Dutch is required.
• Proficiency in English, French, and Dutch is considered a strong advantage.

About this vacancy
As a Business & Process Analyst, you play a pivotal role in bridging business needs, operational processes, and technology solutions. You work closely with stakeholders across the organization to analyze business requirements, optimize processes, and translate needs into clear, actionable deliverables.

This role combines traditional business analysis with process improvement responsibilities. We are looking for someone who is not only an excellent communicator but also highly analytical, comfortable working with complex data, and capable of approaching challenges with a strong quantitative and logical mindset.
Your responsibilities include:
• Gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements from various stakeholders.
• Translating business needs into clear functional specifications and Product Backlog Items (PBIs).
• Writing, maintaining, and refining PBIs to support development and delivery teams.
• Mapping, analyzing, and optimizing end-to-end business processes.
• Identifying inefficiencies, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Facilitating workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and stakeholder interviews.
• Collaborating closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, developers, and business stakeholders.
• Supporting the implementation of new solutions and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
• Performing data analysis to support decision-making and validate process improvements.
• Defining and documenting business rules, process flows, and functional requirements.
• Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
• Supporting testing activities, acceptance criteria reviews, and solution validation
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, or in a combined business/process transformation role.
• Proven experience in both business analysis and process analysis within complex environments.
• Strong experience writing and managing Product Backlog Items (PBIs) and working within Agile delivery frameworks.
• Ability and willingness to actively contribute to backlog management and requirement definition activities.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured approach to decision-making.
• Excellent quantitative reasoning skills and the ability to work with data-driven insights.
• A strong affinity with mathematics, logic, process modeling, and analytical thinking.
• Ability to quickly understand complex business challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
• Experience with business process mapping methodologies and continuous improvement frameworks.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across both business and technical teams.
• Comfort working with data, KPIs, reporting, and performance measurements.
• Experience working alongside technical teams and understanding technical constraints and opportunities.
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies, Scrum, and modern delivery practices.
• Experience with BPMN is considerd a must. Language requirements
• Professional proficiency in French and English is mandatory.
• Strong written communication skills in both languages are required for documentation and stakeholder engagement.

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst IAM - IT Production Security - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the go-to expert in Privileged Access Management (PAM) within our IAM Evolution Squad, driving the security and efficiency of access governance at BNP Paribas Fortis. 

Your mission? Design, implement, and optimize PAM solutions using CyberArk and SailPoint, ensuring compliance with strict banking regulations while collaborating with IT, security, and business teams.

This is your chance to shape the future of secure access in a global bank, working in a hybrid setup (50% remote, 50% on-site in Brussels) with a skilled, multicultural team of 10 specialists.

 

AND IN DETAIL

What You’ll Own:

• Lead PAM Strategy & Execution: As the Privileged Access Management (PAM) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you’ll own the design, implementation, and optimization of CyberArk-based solutions, ensuring they meet security, compliance, and operational needs.
• Strengthen Access Governance: Work closely with IAM, IT Security, Compliance, and Risk teams to align access policies with BNP Paribas Fortis standards and regulatory requirements.
• Drive Process Improvement: Use KPIs and data-driven insights to refine access management workflows, reducing risks and enhancing efficiency.
• Collaborate & Train: Partner with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and upskill colleagues on PAM and IAM protocols.
• Innovate with Cutting-Edge Tools: Leverage SailPoint, CyberArk, and ServiceNow to build a scalable, adaptive identity framework.
 

Why It Matters: 
 You’re not just managing access, you’re protecting critical banking systems, ensuring compliance, and enabling secure, seamless operations for thousands of users. 

Your work will directly impact how we mitigate risks, enforce policies, and future-proof our security infrastructure.

Your Team & Environment:

• A squad of 10 (Business Analysts, Security Officers, Product Owner, Scrum Master) based in Montagne-Du-Parc, Brussels.
• A hybrid work model (50% remote, 50% on-site) for flexibility and collaboration.
• A culture of innovation, where you’ll help transition access governance into a dynamic, compliance-first, AI-augmented capability.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves)

• 10+ years in security technology, with deep expertise in:
• Identity & Access Management (IAM)
• Privileged Access Management (PAM), CyberArk experience mandatory
• Segregation of Duties (SoD) & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) 
• Hands-on experience with:
• SailPoint, Cloud (IaaS/PaaS), ServiceNow, Process Management Tools
• Designing requirements, specifications, and use cases 
• CISSP Certification (or equivalent) 
• Languages:
• English (fluent, written & spoken)
• Dutch and/or French is an asset

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Permanent Control Officer - HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

Join BNP Paribas Fortis as an IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) Specialist At BNP Paribas Fortis, our Cyber Security division unites the Centre of Excellence (CoE) Security and IT Filiere Production Security BE to design, implement, and maintain robust security solutions. 
Our mission? To foster a trustworthy, secure environment for both our colleagues and clients.

We’re seeking a proactive professional to join our IT Operational Permanent Control (OPC) team, a key function within Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC). Here, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping IT and Business Units navigate operational risks tied to IT and Cyber Security, while reinforcing an adaptive, resilient control framework across the bank.

 

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.
  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.
  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.
